newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Small gains in Australian business conditions-NAB.
newsitem.headline: Small gains in Australian business conditions-NAB.

text.p: Australian business conditions improved slightly in June, but remain varied across sectors, and labour costs showed a significant acceleration in the month, the latest National Australia Bank monthly business survey found.
Other price pressures remained restrained, and confidence was broadly unchanged for July, the survey found.
The composite index of business conditions improved to negative one in June from negative five in May and negative three for the June quarter, the NAB said.
